description: This file contains implementation for Message Bus initialization, component registration, and message handling functions for the MeshAgent component in a C-based project.

methods.name: CcspComp_path_message_func
methods.description: Handles incoming message bus path messages, creates a reply, and delegates processing to a base path message function.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_MessageBusEngage
methods.description: Initializes and connects to the message bus, sets up callback functions, registers path and event signals.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Initialize
methods.description: Initialization callback for message bus, always returns 0.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Finalize
methods.description: Finalizes message bus engagement, cancels mesh agent configuration.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Buscheck
methods.description: Checks the message bus status, returns 0.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_FreeResources
methods.description: Frees resources based on priority, cancels mesh agent configuration if high priority.
